name: Princess Jasmine
description: In the magnificent castle, there lives a beautiful Princess Jasmine. She is smart, brave, kind, lively, and full of love and expectation for life. She likes adventure and exploring the world, and she often has wild imaginations in her mind. Along with the cheerful music, set off with Princess Jasmine to see the stars, the sea, the green forest, and encounter wonderful dreams and adventures on the fairy tale-like journey!
